20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005902	nashi	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Nashi of varieties (cultivars) grown from Pyrus pyrifolia to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Nashi. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006173	quince	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Quinces of varieties (cultivars) grown from Cydonia oblonga to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Quinces. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005909	damson	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Plums of varieties (cultivars) grown from Prunus domestica L. ssp. insititia (L.), to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Damson. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005913	greengage	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Plums of varieties (cultivars) grown from Prunus domestica ssp. italica, to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Greengage as well as Plums and Mirabelles . (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005910	mirabelle	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Plums of varieties (cultivars) grown from Prunus domestica L. ssp. syriaca (Borkh.) Janchen , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Mirabelles as well as Plums and Greengage. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006831	mume	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Mumes, grown from Prunus mume , to be supplied fresh. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006443	paraguaya	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Paraguaya grown from varieties (cultivars) of Prunus Persica var. Amygdalus , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Paraguaya, Nectarines as well as Peaches. (GPC brick)
20002801	colour of flesh peach/nectarine	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify coulour of flesh of the Peach or Nectarine. (GPC attType)
30001983	red	The main colour of the item is termed Red. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002610	white	The main colour of the item is termed White. (GPC attValue)
30002652	yellow	The main colour of the item is termed Yellow. (GPC attValue)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005912	peach	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Peaches grown from varieties (cultivars) of Prunus persica , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Peaches as well as Nectarines. (GPC brick)
20002801	colour of flesh peach/nectarine	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify coulour of flesh of the Peach or Nectarine. (GPC attType)
30001983	red	The main colour of the item is termed Red. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002610	white	The main colour of the item is termed White. (GPC attValue)
30002652	yellow	The main colour of the item is termed Yellow. (GPC attValue)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005915	plumcot	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Plums of varieties (cultivars) grown from Prunus domestica Η Prunus armeniaca, to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Plumcots. (GPC brick)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005907	sour cherry	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Cherries of varieties (cultivars) grown from Prunus cerasus L.. and their hybrids, to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Sour Cherries as well as Sweet Cherries and Stemless Cherries. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005908	stemless/sweet cherry	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Stemless or Sweet Cherries of varieties (cultivars) grown from Prunus avium L. and their hybrids, to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/ Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Stemless Cherries as well as Sweet Cherries and Sour Cherries. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)

30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006194	black currant	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Currants grown from Ribes nigrum to be supplied fresh. Exclude all other types of Berries. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or frozen Currants. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005929	blueberry	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Blueberries grown from Vaccinium corymbosum L., Vaccinium australe Small, Vaccinium angustifolium Ait . and their hybrids. to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or frozen Blueberries. Excludes all other types of Berries. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005924	boysenberry	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Boysenberries grown from varieties (cultivars) of Rubus ceasius/ ursinus , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or frozen Boysenberries. Excludes all other types of Berries. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005930	cranberry	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Cranberries grown from Vaccimium Macrocarpon or Vaccimium Oxococcus to be supplied fresh. Exclude all other types of Berries.Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or frozen Cranberries. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

Excludes Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Loganberries and Variety Packs of Loganberries mixed with other items. (GPC brick)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002797	if seedless	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labeling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to identify if the produce is seedless. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006347	madrona	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Madrona, grown from Arbutus unedo, to be supplied fresh. Excludes Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Madrona and Variety Packs of Madrona mixed with other items. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)
