20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006038	pumpkins/winter squash	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Pumpkins/Winter Squash of varieties (cultivars) grown from Cucurbita maxima to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Pumpkins. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006337	corn (indian)	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Corn, Indian, grown from Zea mays indurata, to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Corn, Indian and Variety Packs of Corn, Indian mixed with other items. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002803	if mini	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to indicates whether or not the produce is a Mini or Baby product. Miniature product means a variety or cultivar of vegetable, obtained by plant breeding and/or special cultivation techniques, excluding specimens of non-miniature varieties which have not fully developed or are of inadequate size. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
10005996	brussel sprout	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Brussels Sprouts of varieties (cultivars) grown from Brassica oleracea L. var. gemmifera DC to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Brussels Sprouts. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

(GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)

30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)

20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006446	choi sum	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Choi Sum grown from Brassica rapa var. Parachinensis , to be supplied fresh. Excludes Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Choi Sumi and Variety Packs of Choi Sum mixed with other items. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002917	type of kale	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the type of Kale. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006116	may turnip	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of  May turnips of varieties (cultivars) grown from Brassica rapa var. rapifera subvar. majalis. to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen May turnips. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. 30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006197	pointed cabbage	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Pointed Cabbage of varieties (cultivars) grown from Brassica oleracea convar.capitata var. capitata , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Pointed Cabbage. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002803	if mini	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to indicates whether or not the produce is a Mini or Baby product. Miniature product means a variety or cultivar of vegetable, obtained by plant breeding and/or special cultivation techniques, excluding specimens of non-miniature varieties which have not fully developed or are of inadequate size. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005997	red cabbage	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Red Cabbage of varieties (cultivars) grown from Brassica oleracea var. capitata to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Red Cabbage.. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002803	if mini	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to indicates whether or not the produce is a Mini or Baby product. Miniature product means a variety or cultivar of vegetable, obtained by plant breeding and/or special cultivation techniques, excluding specimens of non-miniature varieties which have not fully developed or are of inadequate size. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006196	romanesco	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Romanesco of varieties (cultivars) grown from Brassica oleracea convar. botrytis , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Romanesco. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002951	type of savoy cabbage	 (GPC attType)
30001173	green	The main colour of the item is termed Green. (GPC attValue)
30014886	pointed	Pointed Savoy Cabbage is a dark green head cabbage with curly leaves and a head pointed in shape. It is easily distinguished from the Pointed Cabbage, which is also pointed but white with flat leaves and a compact head. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002652	yellow	The main colour of the item is termed Yellow. (GPC attValue)
10006118	swedish turnip (rutabagas)	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Swedish turnips (cultivars) grown from Brassica napus var. Napobrassica. to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Swedish Turnips. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)

30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

(GPC attType)

30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)

10005999	white cabbage	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of White Cabbage of varieties (cultivars) grown from Brassica oleracea convar. capitata to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared, Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen White Cabbage. (GPC brick)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002803	if mini	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to indicates whether or not the produce is a Mini or Baby product. Miniature product means a variety or cultivar of vegetable, obtained by plant breeding and/or special cultivation techniques, excluding specimens of non-miniature varieties which have not fully developed or are of inadequate size. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
50261300	herb	 (GPC class)
10006334	anise	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Anise, grown from Pimpinella anisum, to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Anise and Variety Packs of Anise mixed with other items. (GPC brick)
20002789	colour of herbs/leave	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the colour of the herbs or the leaves. (GPC attType)
30000720	combination	 (GPC attValue)
30001173	green	The main colour of the item is termed Green. (GPC attValue)
30001983	red	The main colour of the item is termed Red. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002788	if potted	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the herb is sold in pot or cut. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002806	leaf variant of herb	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the leaf variant of the herb. (GPC attType)
30015374	big leave	 (GPC attValue)
30015373	salat leave	 (GPC attValue)
30015372	small leave	 (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006050	archangel	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Archangel grown from Angelica archangelica to be supplied fresh. Exclude all Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and frozen or shelf stable Archangel. (GPC brick)
20002789	colour of herbs/leave	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the colour of the herbs or the leaves. (GPC attType)

20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002788	if potted	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the herb is sold in pot or cut. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002806	leaf variant of herb	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the leaf variant of the herb. (GPC attType)
30015374	big leave	 (GPC attValue)
30015373	salat leave	 (GPC attValue)

30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006071	burnet saxifrage	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Burnet Saxifrage grown from Pimpinella anisum to be supplied fresh. Exclude all Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and frozen or shelf stable Burnet Saxifrage. (GPC brick)
20002789	colour of herbs/leave	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the colour of the herbs or the leaves. (GPC attType)
30000720	combination	 (GPC attValue)

30001983	red	The main colour of the item is termed Red. (GPC attValue)

20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002788	if potted	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the herb is sold in pot or cut. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002806	leaf variant of herb	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the leaf variant of the herb. (GPC attType)
30015374	big leave	 (GPC attValue)
30015373	salat leave	 (GPC attValue)

30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006056	caraway	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Caraway grown from Carum carvi to be supplied fresh. Exclude all Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and frozen or shelf stable Caraway. (GPC brick)
20002789	colour of herbs/leave	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the colour of the herbs or the leaves. (GPC attType)

30001983	red	The main colour of the item is termed Red. (GPC attValue)
