20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002788	if potted	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the herb is sold in pot or cut. (GPC attType)
30002960	no	 (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30002654	yes	 (GPC attValue)
20002806	leaf variant of herb	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the leaf variant of the herb. (GPC attType)

30015373	salat leave	 (GPC attValue)

30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

10006834	adzuki bean	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Small Red Beans, grown from Vigna angularis , to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Small Red Beans and Variety Packs of Small Red Beans mixed with other items. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005976	french/wax bean	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of French or Wax Beans of varieties (cultivars) grown from Phaseolus vulgaris L., to be supplied fresh. 20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005979	runner bean	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Runner Beans of varieties (cultivars) grown from Phaseolus coccineus . to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen French Beans. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)

30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006270	snow pea	This standard applies to Snow Pea of varieties (cultivars) grown from Pisum sativum var. saccharatum to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared, Processed and Shelf Stable Snow Pea. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10005985	sugar snap pea	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Sugar Snap Peas (cultivars) grown from Pisum sativum var macrocarpon  to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Sugar Snap Peas. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)

50261600	stem vegetable	 (GPC class)
10006129	asparagu	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Asparagus of varieties (cultivars) grown from Asparagus officinalis L. to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Asparagus. (GPC brick)
20002844	colour of asparagu	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to differentiate the colour of Asparagus. (GPC attType)
30015547	green asparagu	The green colour of asparagus is due to the colouring of chlorophyll by light in asparagus cultivars grown in open cultivation. (GPC attValue)
30015546	purple asparagu	The purple colour of asparagus results from the presence of anthocyanin in cultivars that are grown in open cultivation which turn the shoot dark purple with possibly violet or green ferns. (violet green) (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
30015545	violett asparagu	This term is used for asparagus with white stalks and violet heads, caused by the fact that the asparagus is grown in covered cultivations but harvested after the heads have grown out of the covering. (GPC attValue)
30015544	white asparagu	This term is used for asparagus with white stalks and heads due to completely covered cultivation that prevents colouring by light. (GPC attValue)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006137	bamboo shoot	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Bamboo shoots of varieties (cultivars) grown from Bambusa vulgaris to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Bamboo shoots. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006131	celery	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Celery of varieties (cultivars) grown from Apium graveolens L. var. dulce Mill.. to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Celery Leaves, Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Celery. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006272	fennel (subspecies azoricum)	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial Fennel of varieties (cultivars) grown from Foeniculum vulgare. Specifically excludes: Prepared, Processed and Shelf Stable Fennel. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006133	leek	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Leek of varieties (cultivars) grown from Allium porrum L to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Leek. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006136	palm heart	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Palm hearts (cultivars) grown from Euter pa oleracea, Cocos nucifera, Bactrisgasipaes, daemonorops schmidtiana to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Palm Hearts. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006835	sweet potato stem	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Sweet Potato Stems, grown from Ipomoea batatas , to be supplied fresh. Excludes sweet potatoes. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006033	chanterelle	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of varieties (cultivars) grown from Cantharellus cibarius to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Chanterelle. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. 30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)

30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)

30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006836	lingzhi mushroom	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Lingzhi Mushrooms, grown from Ganoderma lucidum , to be supplied fresh. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006034	shiitake mushroom	Includes any product that can be described/observed as a fresh commercial variety of Shiitake of varieties (cultivars) grown from Lentinula edodes to be supplied fresh. Specifically excludes: Prepared/Processed or Unprepared/Unprocessed and Shelf Stable or Frozen Shiitake. (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002737	quality (unece standard)	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the quality classification or category according to Codex Alimentarius or UNECE standards. UNCLASSIFIED applies to fruits that are not yet packed (e.g. delivery of a grower to a pack house) or not qualified to be sold as fresh fruits in the target market since they do not meet the specifications required by legislation. (GPC attType)
30014956	"extra" class	Products in this class must be of superior quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type specified. Depending on the nature of the produce specific provisions can apply as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. They must be free from defects, with the exception of very slight superficial defects, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package. (GPC attValue)
30014608	class i	Products in this class must be of good quality. They must be characteristic of the variety and/or commercial type. There can be specific provisions, depending on the nature of the produce as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. Slight defects, however, may be allowed, provided these do not affect the general appearance of the produce, the quality, the keeping quality and presentation in the package:- a slight defect in shape- slight defects in colouring- slight skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30014609	class ii	This class includes products that do not qualify for inclusion in a higher classes but satisfy the minimum requirements for this product as specified in the UNECE Standards for Fresh Fruit and vegetables. The following defects may be allowed, provided the produce retain their essential characteristics as regards the quality, the keeping quality and presentation:- defects in shape- defects in colouring- skin defects. (GPC attValue)
30002515	unclassified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
10006266	wild mushroom (other)	Includes any product that can be described/observed as several types of fresh mushrooms sparsely cultivated or found wild which should be identified on attribute level. Specifically excludes: Prepared, Processed and Shelf Stable wild mushrooms, excludes separately identified mushrooms in this class (e.g. truffle, cantharelle). (GPC brick)
20000743	country/zone of origin	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer fruits/vegetables to identify the specific country in which the product has grown. (GPC attType)

20003028	eu and non-eu declaration	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to indicate whether the components consist of EU and/or non-EU countries. (GPC attType)
30017715	mix of eu and non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from both EU and non-EU countries. (GPC attValue)
30017713	mix of eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30017714	mix of non-eu fruits and vegetable	This term is used to indicate that there is a mix of fruits and/or vegetables from non-EU countries only. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002739	growing method	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the presence of an industry recognized "Organic" or "Transitional" certification upon the product labelling or packaging. (GPC attType)
30014685	conventional	This term is used to indicate that the growing method is not organic, neither Transitional. (GPC attValue)
30014683	organic	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labelling. (GPC attValue)
30014684	transitional	This term is used to indicate the presence of an industry recognized Organic certification upon the product labeling, but the manufacturer or producer is still in the process of getting the certification to get the label organic. (GPC attValue)
30002518	unidentified	This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information. (GPC attValue)
20002837	variety of wild fresh mushroom	Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the variety of Wild Fresh Mushrooms, although sometimes these may be cultivated. (GPC attType)
30015533	almond mushroom	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Almond Mushroom (cultivars), also known as Mushroom of the Sun, God's Mushroom, Mushroom of Life, Royal Sun Agaricus, Jisongrong or Himematsutake, of variety Agaricus subrufescens. (GPC attValue)
30015522	ear jelly fungi	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Ear Jelly Fungi (cultivars), also known as Judas Ear, Jew's Ear, Jelly Ear or Wood Ear Mushroom of variety Auricularia auricula. (GPC attValue)
30015526	grey mushroom	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Grey or Grey-Capped Mushroom (cultivars) of variety Tricholoma terreum. (GPC attValue)
30015524	grisette	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Grisette (cultivars) of variety Amanita vaginata and Amanita fulva. (GPC attValue)
30015532	maitake	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Maitake (cultivars), also known as Hen-of-the-Woods, Ram's Head and Sheep's Head, of variety Grifola frondosa. (GPC attValue)
30015521	mousseron	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Mousseron (cultivars), also known as Scotch Bonnet or Fairy Ring Mushroom, of variety marasmius oreades. (GPC attValue)
30015528	nameko	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Nameko (cultivars) of variety Pholiota nameko. (GPC attValue)
30015530	pied de mouton	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Pied De Mouton (cultivars), also known as Hedgehog Mushroom, of variety Hydnum repandum. (GPC attValue)
30015529	pompom blanc	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Pom Pom Blanc (cultivars), also known as Lion's Mane Mushroom, Bearded Tooth Mushroom, Monkey Head, Satyr's Beard, Bearded Hedgehog Mushroom, or Bearded Tooth Fungus, of variety Hericium erinaceus. (GPC attValue)
30015525	saffron milk-cap	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Saffron Milk-Cap (cultivars) of variety Lactarius deliciosus. (GPC attValue)
30015523	sheep polypore	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Sheep Polypore (cultivars) of variety Albatrellus ovinus. (GPC attValue)
30015531	trompette	Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fresh wild variety of Trompette (cultivars), also known as Trumpet of Death, Black Chanterelle, Black Trumpet, or Horn of Plenty, of variety Craterellus cornucopioides. (GPC attValue)

10006171	vegetables - unprepared/unprocessed (fresh)	Includes any products that can be described/observed as two or more distinct Vegetables, sold together which exist within the schema but belong to different classes, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross classes within the Vegetables - Unprepared/Unprocessed (Fresh) Family. Includes products such as Tomatoes and Cucumbers variety packs. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
